verdict.rationale: Business-hours routing is a fair question for a cloud phone and contact-center product like Dialpad, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item mentions business hours, open/closed schedules, holiday behavior, or per-number hour rules. Company-wide number blocking and queue operator assignment are related call controls, not business-hours configuration, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can set business hours with open, closed, and holiday behavior per number
